scheme_name: Credit Based Schemes For SC - Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana (Livelihood Microfinance Scheme)
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category and be an entrepreneur seeking micro‑finance for a small income‑generating activity
Annual family income must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000
Application must be submitted through the nearest channeling agency or district office of the designated State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs)
benefits_summary: Provides up to 90% of project cost (maximum Rs 1.40 Lakhs) at interest rates of 11% (10% for women) with a repayment period of up to 3.5 years.
